src_seg:
Declan’s mind flickered through every worry he’d been carrying since stepping off that bus. Was Kyle reading him that easily? It felt like he was peeling back layers without even trying. That low, familiar buzz of uncertainty crept up again, and somehow, Kyle seemed to catch it without a word.
“I know it’s not easy, kid.” Kyle gave a small, almost fatherly sigh. His voice was lower now; gentle, but steady. “But here’s the thing. If you stay with us, you’re not just crashing at a billet house. I’m offering you space to breathe. A place to land when everything else feels like it’s spinning.”
tgt_seg:
德克兰脑海里闪过自下车以来所有的担忧。凯尔是不是这么容易就看穿了他？感觉他不费吹灰之力就能剥开他的心思。那种熟悉的不安又浮上心头，而凯尔似乎不动声色地捕捉到了。
“我知道这不容易，孩子。”凯尔轻叹一声，声音低沉温和，却很坚定。“但你要明白，如果你住在我们家，不只是暂住寄宿家庭。我给你的是喘息的空间。是当一切都天旋地转时，你能落脚的地方。”

src_seg: I hope Johnson is pleased with the way things have worked out. Because now the foolish wokerati have been schooled beyond Johnson's wettest dreams. It's the Trump-Putin-bin Salman party! An adjudicated sex offender and convicted fraudster, and a man who sanctioned a chemical warfare hit, killing a British citizen on British soil, have met at the luxury Saudia Arabian hotel of another man, who, according to the US, reportedly approved the murder and subsequent dismemberment of a journalist, to discuss the similarly brutal dismemberment of Ukraine, without consulting either Ukraine itself or the countries most directly affected by the legitimisation of Putin's territorial anxieties. Don't worry, Poland! Stable genius Trump has got this covered, so break out the bone saws, pop the cork on the novichok and grab the girls by the pussy! There are 1970s Italian slasher films with less gruesome plotlines. Well said, Boris Johnson! That's certainly stuck it to the wokerati!
tgt_seg: 但愿约翰逊对事态发展感到满意。因为如今"觉醒派"遭受的教训远超他最狂野的想象。这是特朗普-普京-萨勒曼的狂欢派对！一位被裁定的性侵犯者、定罪的欺诈犯，与一位批准使用化学武器在英国领土杀害英国公民的凶手，在另一位据美国指控涉嫌批准谋杀并肢解记者的沙特富豪的豪华酒店里会晤，商讨对乌克兰实施同样残酷的肢解——既未咨询乌克兰，也未顾及受普京领土焦虑合法化直接影响最深的国家。别担心波兰！天才特朗普已掌控全局，快拿出骨锯、打开诺维乔克毒剂的瓶盖、像抓小猫那样抓住女孩们吧！1970年代的意大利恐怖片都没这般骇人剧情。说得好啊，鲍里斯·约翰逊！这真是给"觉醒派"一记响亮的耳光！

src_seg: For a brief period around teatime on Monday, Keir Starmer, who once left his "village and went to the city of Leeds" and "discovered a whole new world of indie bands - like Orange Juice and the Wedding Present" delusionally imagined he could be some kind of go-between twixt observable reality and Trump. But did West Yorkshire jangle-pop pioneers the Wedding Present radically retool their signature sound for 1991"s Seamonsters album just so Starmer could become a Neville Chamberlain for the cover-mounted fanzine flexidisc generation?
tgt_seg: 周一傍晚时分，基尔·斯塔默，这位曾离开“村庄前往利兹市”并“发现了全新的独立乐队世界——比如橙汁乐队和婚礼现场乐队”的人，狂妄地想象自己可以成为观察现实与特朗普之间的某种中间人。但西约克郡的抖动流行乐先锋“婚礼现场乐队”是否在1991年的《海怪》专辑中彻底改变了他们的标志性风格，只是为了让斯塔默成为封面挂载的粉丝杂志柔性唱片一代的张伯伦？
